text: The Patriots are heading into their Week 5 matchup against the Raiders significantly undermanned on the defensive back front, with starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) both ruled out, though there's some positive news on the offensive side as running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after his absence. The team made several roster adjustments ahead of Sunday's game, placing veteran wideout Mack Hollins and fullback Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve while activating safety Brenden Schooler to the 53-man roster and signing cornerback Kindle Vildor from the practice squad—moves that speak to both the injuries piling up and the team's attempt to shore up secondary depth. In a lighter note, the Patriots will honor Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri with an induction ceremony during halftime, and the team will dust off their throwback uniforms for the occasion. The Raiders will bring a formidable passing attack to Foxborough, with Kirk Cousins having enjoyed one of the season's most surprising hot starts, making the Patriots' secondary situation even more precarious than usual.
